systems.country_label: Registre national de l'état civil; programme Nekkal
systems.owner: not stated; the Nekkal programme is EU-financed (FCFA 18 billion grant, launched 7 May 2020 for 42 months)
systems.tiers: national register into which the digitised records are centralised

note: No fact: the record states only back-capture, more than 19 million civil-status records digitised and indexed by June 2024 and centralised in the national register, under an EU grant of FCFA 18 billion; it says nothing of offices entering events digitally. It also gives the national civil-status strategy's budget as FCFA 68 billion.
